referenced_message.content:
I'm retiring from the IBL.

In case it wasn't obvious from me leaving IBL and all related servers, I have made the decision to fully withdraw from the IBL and its community. The IBL is no longer a place I feel welcomed in, and I suspect I have not been welcome here for at least a couple of months. If this was your goal, congrats, I guess. You have succeeded. 

Like I mentioned in my removal from power messages, I have been here since the beginning. I wanted to help out in any way I could and I loved volunteering my time and efforts to help move the IBL forward, be it as a Commissioner, the Head of Rules & Regulations, or even simply just as a Game Host/Referee or Stats Nerd (thank you Chan for the wonderful name). I never did this with expectation of external reward, as I simply got gratification from knowing the work I did was important. And yet, my contributions would barely be noticed or celebrated. For all I gave to the community, I didn't often feel like I was valued by them. I cannot overstate the work it took to be a consistently contributing member of Game Staff, to constantly oversee every game scheduling thread to ensure all games get scheduled within 3 weeks or less, to write the Rulebook nearly alone; what credit did I get? The credit I did get, I don't feel was enough for all I contributed.
Many of you seem to have a problem with me. I would have appreciated you telling me, but clearly it was not worth your time to actually work out your issues with me. The only time someone actually said they had a problem with me, back in February of this year, they reached out to my close friend and Team Owner at the time, Kaydence. We talked about how I had made a couple of minors uncomfortable by making sexual jokes and generally being insensitive around minors, and I resolved to change my behaviors moving forward; I have continued to uphold that promise to this day. I know that people have issues with my temper and parts of my personality, but since nobody actually told me about these being legitimate issues people had with me until very recently, nothing was done about those behaviors when it actually mattered.

I'm going to find a place that will acknowledge all I have to offer. The dedication, knowledge, and effort I know I can bring will be appreciated by someone. But it wasn't you, the community I've poured the last 2 years of my life into. And for that, I am truly disappointed.
